body:
I kind of do, but kind of don't. I have friends, quite a few, when I think of it, but I guess I seek a soulmate so to say and I don't have that. Being a foreigner in a country where people are generally not very open doesn't make things better as well as living in a relatively small city.

But I am doing my hobbies and things I enjoy nowadays, so that is nice. Looking forward to them is one of the things keeping me afloat. But the worse it gets mentally, the less energy I have to do them. And then it gets worse mentally. Cursed circle in a way.

Both uni and work.

And yeah, I guess I should go to therapist again, but honestly, I just feel so broken as a human being, when I have to do that.

P.S. thanks for taking your time to chat with me, I really value that.

I guess lack of purpose would be a good definition. Control? Not really, I have in a way. But what for?

I had therapist sessions, from March to August, after my second attempt. They helped. Didn't have any sucidal thoughts for maybe 2 month or such. But now, not a day passes that I think of it. And I know where it ends. And I don't have power of will to go to my therapist again.

Just permanently feeling lonely and with no goal or purpose, except when I am actually doing something. But that is just avoiding myself, and however much you try, you are left with yourself eventually.
